SELECT ts_doy, ts_hour, wtmp_c, ROUND(wtmp_c * 9/5 + 32, 1) AS wtmp_f
FROM pier
WHERE ts_season = 2
ORDER BY ts_t DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(*) as trips, ROUND(SUM(yt) / SUM(anglers), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy >= 172
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, cls;

SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(*) as trips, ROUND(SUM(yt) / SUM(anglers), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy >= 260
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls;
